results.detail: Correct: the CastingError output (Create gen_fundEnrolment) and the CustingError output (pension Create Fund Enrolment) have no paths. Update Reject Management's Failure output goes to an empty Derived Column (DTSX:14623) with no continuation. ErrorMessage there is wstr(200) (DTSX:15623), and that caveat is correctly marked as documented SSIS behaviour. Problems: (1) 'ההצטרפויות יישלפו שוב בריצה הבאה' is stated unconditionally, but the outcome depends on data. The automated-joining source has no Fund Enrolment condition. It re-selects a joining only while gen_joiningstatus = 2 and (gen_lastsyncdate is null or < ModifiedOn) (DTSX:3415-3417). A retry happens only if the full-cache Lookup finds no Fund Enrolment. When a joining has several transfer-request rows and one of them was created, later runs skip it, so the failed sibling is never retried. Pension joinings are re-selected only while they still meet the WHERE clause (status 2/4 or passedandreject, plus a reject indicator). (2) The finding applies the documented 'string longer than the buffer column throws' caveat to the 200-character column but not to the same pattern in the create catches. Description is wstr(2000) (DTSX:3346) and ErrorMessage is wstr(2000) (DTSX:6861). Also, catch(SoapException) reads se.Detail.InnerText (main.cs:284, DTSX:1913); if Detail is null, that line throws inside the catch. In those cases the row is not 'lost silently': the component and the data flow fail.

wrongUnits.problem: The re-fetch is stated unconditionally, and the same overflow caveat is not applied to the 2000-character error columns.
wrongUnits.correct: Failed creations are dropped without a log, as long as the error text fits the wstr(2000) error column (and, for SoapException, Detail is not null). A failed automated joining is retried in a later run only if it is still in status 2 and gen_lastsyncdate is null or earlier than ModifiedOn, and only if no other row of the same joining created a Fund Enrolment. A failed pension joining is retried only while it still meets the source filter.

results.detail: Units 1-28 and 30-34 match the DTSX and main.cs. Source: DTSX:3357-3418. Notes: main.cs:117-129. Lookup: full cache (CacheType 0), Match not connected. Dead split: DTSX:1463. Units 1-8 are correct (WHERE at DTSX:6934-6937; main.cs:136-151; field set 153-325; SQL updates DTSX:8100/8056). Unit 9 gives one failure mode of note building: an empty value, if a NULL read throws. It misses a second one that does not depend on NULL handling. Set gen_note writes the combined note to output column gen_note, which is wstr(1000) (DTSX:8047). It is built from four reason names of wstr(300) each plus gen_rejectreasonsnotes of wstr(2000) (cast(... as nvarchar(2000))). The assignment Row.gennote = note (DTSX:7407; setter this[5] = value, DTSX:7700) is outside any try, and the component has no error output. Per documented SSIS behaviour (not shown in the files), assigning a string longer than the column throws (DoesNotFitBufferException). So a joining whose reasons plus notes exceed 1000 characters fails the whole data flow, and the later Success-chained steps do not run.
